name: @red-cup-engineering/pnpm-workspace-fabrication-service
description: Fabricates an explicitly ordered pnpm workspace as a customer artifact without granting workspace authority over the provider organism.

scripts.verify: node --check src/fabricate-pnpm-workspace.mjs && node --check bin/fabricate-pnpm-workspace.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs

fabricate-pnpm-workspace.accepts: one explicit customer workspace specification and one output territory
fabricate-pnpm-workspace.returns: one bounded pnpm workspace artifact and content receipt
